title: BaselineSuite
description: Schema for a complete baseline suite for one agent: all canonical prompts with N=30 runs each, aggregated statistics, and suite-level metadata. One suite file per agent.

agent_definition_path.description: Repo-relative path to the agent definition file.

agent_definition_git_hash.description: Git commit hash of the agent definition file at capture time. This hash plus agent_definition_path uniquely identifies the captured agent version.

model_version.description: Exact Anthropic API model identifier used for all runs in this suite.

judge_model_version.description: Exact model identifier used for LLM-as-Judge evaluation for all runs in this suite.

capture_session_id.description: Primary capture session ID. If capture spanned multiple sessions (due to interruption), this is the first session; additional_session_ids lists the rest.

additional_session_ids.description: Additional session IDs if capture was resumed across multiple sessions.

suite_created_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this suite file was generated by aggregate_suites.py.

target_runs_per_prompt.description: Target number of valid (non-error) runs per prompt. Baseline protocol standard is 30.

prompts.description: Array of prompt-level baseline records, one per canonical test prompt for this agent.

suite_statistics.description: Aggregate statistics across all prompts and runs in this suite.

total_runs_attempted.description: Total run records in this suite including errors.

total_runs_valid.description: Total run records with api_error=null and evaluation_error=null.

total_runs_api_error.description: Total runs that failed at the API invocation layer.

total_runs_eval_error.description: Total runs that succeeded at invocation but failed at evaluation.

overall_median_composite.description: Median weighted composite score across all valid runs in the suite.

overall_mean_composite.description: Mean weighted composite score across all valid runs in the suite.

overall_stdev_composite.description: Standard deviation of weighted composite scores across all valid runs in the suite.

overall_pass_rate_at_0_92.description: Fraction of valid runs with weighted_composite >= 0.92.

overall_pass_rate_wilson_ci_lower.description: Lower bound of 95% Wilson score confidence interval for overall_pass_rate_at_0_92.

overall_pass_rate_wilson_ci_upper.description: Upper bound of 95% Wilson score confidence interval for overall_pass_rate_at_0_92.

per_dimension_medians.description: Median score per SSOT quality dimension across all valid runs in the suite.

behaviors_overall_pass_rate.description: Aggregate expected-behaviors pass rate across all prompts and runs.

suite_checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of all run record files included in this suite, computed in sorted run_id order. Used for integrity verification.

baseline_version.description: Semantic version of the baseline protocol used for capture.

quality_gate_result.description: Result of baseline quality gate check (V-006 check). Null if quality gate has not been run.

PromptBaseline.description: Baseline data for one canonical test prompt: N=30 run summaries and per-prompt statistics.

prompt_id.description: Canonical prompt identifier matching the prompt YAML file.

prompt_description.description: Human-readable description of what this prompt tests.

prompt_file_path.description: Repo-relative path to the prompt YAML file.

prompt_git_hash.description: Git commit hash of the prompt YAML file at capture time.

run_count_valid.description: Number of valid (non-error) runs for this prompt. Must be >= 30 for a complete baseline.

run_count_api_error.description: Number of runs that failed at API invocation.

run_count_eval_error.description: Number of runs that failed at evaluation.

run_ids.description: Ordered list of all run_ids for this prompt (including error runs). Used to locate individual run records.

score_distribution.description: Statistical summary of weighted composite scores across all valid runs for this prompt.

stdev.description: Standard deviation of weighted composite scores.

min.description: Minimum weighted composite score across all valid runs.

max.description: Maximum weighted composite score across all valid runs.

p25.description: 25th percentile (first quartile) of weighted composite scores.

p75.description: 75th percentile (third quartile) of weighted composite scores.

pass_rate_at_0_92.description: Fraction of valid runs scoring >= 0.92 (SSOT quality gate threshold).

wilson_ci_lower_0_95.description: Lower bound of 95% Wilson score confidence interval for pass_rate_at_0_92.

wilson_ci_upper_0_95.description: Upper bound of 95% Wilson score confidence interval for pass_rate_at_0_92.

raw_scores.description: Ordered array of all N valid weighted composite scores. Used by statistical engine for Wilcoxon testing against candidate versions.

per_dimension_medians.description: Median score per SSOT quality dimension across all valid runs for this prompt.

behaviors_statistics.description: Statistical summary of expected-behaviors assessment across all valid runs for this prompt.

expected_behaviors.description: List of behavior IDs defined for this prompt.

per_behavior_pass_rates.description: Fraction of valid runs where each behavior was observed (true). Keys are behavior IDs.

mean_behaviors_pass_rate.description: Mean behaviors pass rate across all valid runs.
